topic: spherical defocus as heat-semigroup dynamics on a question space: the G1 experiment design and results connecting heat-kernel defocus to corpus audit instruments

subtopics.scope: The mathematical core: real spherical harmonics as eigenfunctions of the Laplace-Beltrami operator on S^2, the semigroup identity E[Y_lm(B_t^x)] = e^{-l(l+1)t} Y_lm(x), and why Brownian motion on the sphere acts diagonally on the spherical-harmonic basis.
seed_queries: heat kernel on the sphere Laplace-Beltrami eigenfunction expansion
Brownian motion on sphere transition density spherical harmonics semigroup

subtopics.scope: How the semigroup identity was verified empirically: Euler-Maruyama integration of tangent-vector Brownian motion on S^2, Fibonacci lattice sampling as the quasi-uniform design, and pooled per-degree regression of E[Y(X_t)] on Y(X_0).
seed_queries: Euler-Maruyama simulation Brownian motion on sphere tangent bundle
Fibonacci lattice spherical sampling quasi-uniform design points

subtopics.scope: The pipeline that maps corpus rows onto the sphere: z-scoring 9-column coverage vectors, PCA to 2 dimensions, RMS rescaling, stereographic lift to S^2, and ridge regression of a fitted field on 16 real spherical harmonics with L2 penalty.
seed_queries: stereographic projection embedding 2D data on the sphere
ridge regression fitting data with spherical harmonics basis

subtopics.scope: Why the closed-form defocus law fails on the real 2286x9 corpus: only 176 distinct rows among 512 possible values, point masses instead of a smooth point cloud, Gram matrix far from (N/4pi)I on the distinct-support scale, and coherent fit collapse at infinitesimal diffusion.
seed_queries: spherical harmonic analysis non-uniform discrete sampling aliasing Gram matrix
kernel density estimate point masses repeated observations smoothing bandwidth

subtopics.scope: The new instrument the failure produces: A_l(t) = e^{-2l(l+1)t} - E_l(t)/E_l(0) as a cheap scalar atomicity diagnostic, the non-monotone-in-l signature of atomic energy, the persistent floor, and the G1 value A_1(0.005) = 0.59 on yubiOS.
seed_queries: spectral energy decay per spherical harmonic degree diagnostic
heat kernel smoothing scale space signature detect non-smooth data

subtopics.scope: The membership-condition status: why the semigroup identity needs no null (it is a theorem), why the atomicity diagnostic A_l(t) is not yet admitted, and what its null should be: curveball draws with matched marginals where A_null approximately equals A_real so the difference is the corpus-specific part.
seed_queries: degree-preserving permutation null model curveball graph
null hypothesis design matched marginals permutation test diagnostics

subtopics.scope: What the verified defocus operator unlocks: the scale-space channel z(t) with matched nulls, the SLERP geodesic rung ladder as an intrinsic replacement for log-odds amplitude ladders, and sphere Langevin dynamics with stationary density proportional to exp(-Phi/T).
seed_queries: slerp spherical linear interpolation geodesic interpolation points
Langevin dynamics on manifolds stationary distribution gradient flow

subtopics.scope: The generative endpoint: Riemannian score-based diffusion on the sphere (De Bortoli et al. 2022, Huang et al. 2022, exact sphere heat kernels NeurIPS 2023), and the G1 gate that any generative diffusion model must smooth atoms first (vMF bandwidth as a pre-diffusion) or it will model point masses.

diffusion models on manifold heat kernel sphere generative
